patch_description: This crossover retains the strongest parent’s parameter-efficient shared RY/RZ preparation, complete-graph CZ coverage, and two tied CRZ bridges. It adds the faster parent’s global noncommuting RX mixer while reusing the bridge parameter, preserving four parameters per block and 26 total parameters. The added mixer can convert learned phase correlations into measurable Z populations more quickly without weakening the regularization from parameter sharing.
